scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Vashti's sheltered, Machine-mediated existence and introduces Kuno's dangerous desire to break convention by visiting the surface of the earth.

char_kuno.goal: visit the surface of the earth

required_beats: Vashti silences her music, activates isolation, and darkens the room to take a call.
The plate glows and reveals kuno's image, who demands that Vashti visit him in person.
Kuno explains that while travelling on an air ship he saw the stars resembling a man with a sword, and he insists on visiting the surface of the earth.
Vashti warns Kuno that the cold outer air is lethal and contrary to the spirit of the age, prompting him to terminate the connection.
Vashti restores the light and isolation-switch, irritated by the flood of incoming correspondents before shutting them off.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Forces Vashti to overcome her terror of leaving her room after Kuno's refusal to communicate through the Machine threatens to sever their bond.
required_beats: After giving and receiving lectures, Vashti reverently kisses the Book of the Machine and looks up air-ship departures to the northern hemisphere.
Kuno reappears to state he will not speak until she comes in person, then cuts communication when asked if he visited the surface.
Vashti uses a button to open the wall to the tunnel, but shrinks back into her room in fright as the wall closes.
Vashti claims illness to evade visiting, but an automated medical apparatus summoned by Kuno treats her and forces her to admit recovery.
Kuno refuses to explain through the Machine why he cannot leave, declaring something tremendous may happen.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Pushes Vashti out of her isolated sanctuary into physical transit, demonstrating her profound distress when forced to share space with humanity.
required_beats: Vashti opens the wall, leaves her room behind, and summons a transit car to reach the station lift.
At the gangway, the man in front drops his Book, and amid warnings of lateness, Vashti accidentally treads on it as the passengers board.
The air ship seals its glass valves, and Vashti clutches her Book for comfort as the vessel launches over the ocean.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Exposes society's collective revulsion toward the natural world and the absolute authority of the Machine over perception and transit.
required_beats: Vashti catches sight of the coast of Sumatra and its lighthouses through the gloom.
Passengers protest furiously at travelling in the dark, recalling how the Committee of the Machine outlawed racing the sun under threat of Homelessness.
The attendant restores artificial light and shuts out the world by lowering the metal blinds.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To demonstrate Vashti's physical revulsion toward both direct human contact and the unmediated natural world outside the airship.
required_beats: Vashti panics when her window blind flies up, ringing for the attendant to change cabins.
Vashti rebukes the attendant for attempting to steady her with a hand, prompting an apology.
Vashti demands their location as the attendant pushes back a metal blind over Asia to display the Himalayas, which Vashti orders covered.
Vashti recalls the passenger who dropped his book being sent to Sumatra to propagate the race.
Vashti repeatedly peeks out at the earth, shutting the metal blind in succession over the Caucasus and Greece.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish Kuno's illicit heresy against the Machine and the severe penalty awaiting his breach of the underground world.
required_beats: Vashti arrives at kuno's room and announces she can stay only briefly.
Kuno reveals that authorities caught him on the surface and the Committee has threatened him with Homelessness.
Vashti questions why he did not obtain a legal Egression-permit, but Kuno insists he discovered a secret way out.
Vashti condemns his actions and cites the Book to argue that no egress exists except through the vomitories.
Kuno accuses Vashti of worshiping the Machine and insists the Book is wrong because he reached the surface on his own feet.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal how Kuno began his physical ascent beyond the Machine's architecture and discovered an opening to the forgotten past.
required_beats: Kuno walks the platform outside his room to regain a sense of space after Vashti refuses his first call.
Kuno rides the lift platform by platform to the railway-tunnels of the topmost story.
Kuno finds an opening in the tunnel tiles, waves his arm into the black gap, and widens it.
Kuno thrusts his head into the darkness and shouts, hearing the voices of dead workmen and past generations call back to him.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal Kuno's deeper motive for rebellion by exposing the Machine's absolute control over biological legacy.
required_beats: Kuno pauses in recounting his journey.
Kuno discloses that the Committee refused his request to become a father.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish Kuno's reckless initial attempt to breach the tunnel and Vashti's terrified refusal to entertain his heresy.
required_beats: A train rushes by Kuno as he thrusts his head and arms into the breach in the railway-tunnel.
Kuno retreats to the platform, descends in the lift, and returns to his bed.
Kuno contacts Vashti, but she refuses his appeal and forbids him from speaking of such terrible things.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show Kuno preparing his body and scaling the ancient forbidden shaft to breach the surface, while recounting it to a distressed Vashti.
required_beats: Determined to climb the shaft, Kuno exercises his arms daily before summoning a respirator and setting out.
Kuno pushes in more tiles and climbs into the shaft's dark interior on an ancient metal ladder whose rungs slice his gloves.
Kuno cracks his head against a smooth pneumatic stopper in the darkness.
Urged by voices, Kuno leaps toward the center and catches the stopper's handle.
Kuno pauses in his narration as tears well in Vashti's eyes.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To dramatize Kuno's emergence onto the surface and his view of the hills, straining Vashti's endurance of his account.
required_beats: The stopper blows Kuno onto the surface, where he sips the escaping artificial air with bleeding nose and ears while his respirator bobs above.
Kuno stands as artificial air pools in the hollow, but rolls back down when he tries to breathe the bitter air on the slope.
Kuno halts his story doubting Vashti's interest, but she orders him to proceed.
Kuno scales the bank of the hollow to gaze at the hills before stopping again.
Vashti demands to know how he returned to civilization, compelling Kuno to resume.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict the Machine's horrific reclamation of Kuno as he is dragged back into the subterranean world.
required_beats: At sunset, the air fountain fails and Kuno's respirator falls.
Kuno hurries to the bottom of the hollow to listen at the shaft mouth.
A long white worm creeps out onto the grass, and when Kuno stamps on it, it coils around his ankle.
The worm binds Kuno's feet and drags him past the closing stopper down into the shaft.
Kuno strikes his head against the ladder, loses consciousness, and awakens back in his room.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Concludes Vashti's visit by severing her sympathy for Kuno and cementing the Machine's absolute clampdown on the surface world.
required_beats: Vashti turns to leave, warning Kuno that his defiance will end in Homelessness.
Kuno retorts that he wishes it would, recounting how a surface woman came to his help in the dell and was killed by a worm piercing her throat.
Vashti departs from Kuno's room.
Respirators and terrestrial motors are abolished.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Demonstrates the society's descent into dogmatic intellectual decay by formally rejecting direct experience.
required_beats: An advanced lecturer urges his audience to beware of first-hand ideas and instead rely on multi-tier second-hand interpretations.
The audience responds with enthusiastic applause to the address.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes the institutional deification of the Machine and relocates Kuno within Vashti's orbit.
required_beats: The allocution praising the Machine is printed on the first page of the Book of the Machine.
Kuno is transferred from the northern hemisphere to a room in the southern hemisphere near Vashti.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Delivers Kuno's climactic warning of the impending collapse, which Vashti dismisses as absurdity.
required_beats: Vashti receives a message from Kuno, who refuses to visualize his face upon the blue plate.
Kuno tells Vashti that the Machine is stopping.
Vashti laughs at Kuno, angering him until they cease speaking.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To provide the first tangible corroboration of Kuno's warning through minor systemic failures in the Machine.
required_beats: Vashti confides Kuno's claim to a friend that the Machine is stopping.
The friend shares that gasps have begun disfiguring the music, prompting a complaint to the authorities.
The friend reveals the Committee of the Mending Apparatus promised the defect would be remedied shortly.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To demonstrate the breakdown of responsiveness and transparency within the Machine's bureaucratic hierarchy.
required_beats: Vashti petulantly contacts the Committee of the Mending Apparatus demanding immediate repair of the music, but is told the defect will be set right shortly.
When Vashti threatens to appeal directly to the Central Committee, the Committee insists personal complaints must go through them.
Vashti submits her complaint after the Committee promises to forward it.
Vashti asks whether other citizens have complained, but the Committee refuses to answer.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show the steady escalation and variety of mechanical failures spreading across individual chambers.
required_beats: Vashti vents her frustration regarding her defective music to a friend.
The friend counters with their own troubling mechanical failure, reporting a persistent jarring noise.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal the critical failure of the Machine's self-repair system and the populace's pacified submission to its collapse.
required_beats: Across the world, summoned beds fail to appear.
The Committee of the Mending Apparatus admits that it is itself broken and in need of repair.
A famous lecturer urges the global audience to cease complaints and wait patiently for the Mending Apparatus to recover.
The audience applauds the lecturer's plea across the wires.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict Vashti's utter panic as the Machine fails entirely and breaches the sanctuary of her cell.
required_beats: Global communication breaks down entirely as Vashti attempts to call her friend who specializes in sympathy.
Vashti opens her door, recoils from the crowd in the tunnel, and shuts herself back inside.
The heaving floor hurls Vashti from her chair, driving her into frantic prayer, clutching the Book, and striking wildly at buttons.
Vashti accidentally hits the switch that reopens her cell door to the tunnel.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To resolve Vashti and Kuno's estrangement with the knowledge of humanity's survival on the surface before their destruction.
required_beats: Vashti weeps in the dark and hears Kuno weeping in response, asking him if there is any hope.
Kuno tells her there is none for them as Vashti crawls over dead bodies toward him until his blood spurts over her hands.
Kuno kisses Vashti and affirms that he has seen, spoken to, and loved people still living on the surface of the earth.
An air-ship crashes through the vomitory into a ruined wharf, obliterating the city and killing both Vashti and Kuno.
